Example Chemicals — Sustainability Analyst, Brussels
The Group Sustainability team measures and reduces Example Chemicals's environmental footprint. As an analyst you will consolidate greenhouse-gas data across sites, run product carbon footprints and life-cycle assessments, and help business units set reduction roadmaps aligned with SBTi.
Requirements:
- Master's degree in engineering, environmental science or similar
- 0–2 years of experience; an internship in sustainability or LCA is a strong plus
- Knowledge of the GHG Protocol (scopes 1–3) and LCA software (SimaPro or GaBi)
- Strong Excel; Power BI or Python is a plus
- Fluent English; French or Dutch appreciated
